integrity: All proofs and certificates are supplied; exact finite Grassmannian enumeration is reproducible. The review is non-independent.
scientific_limitations: The exact dimension and quadratic-support census are for F_3[t]/(t^4) alone. The 252 supports are subspaces, not isomorphism classes of evolution envelopes. The lower bound uses fully exhaustive finite-field enumeration. An equivalent unindexed symmetric-rank computation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The ternary length-four truncated-polynomial algebra has evolution dimension eight and 252 optimal quadratic supports
